title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
paper_type_zh: 开放推理模型数据、对齐与压缩技术报告
best_for_zh: 研究推理轨迹构造、工具验证、偏好优化、思考预算与蒸馏复现的读者
one_line: Nemotron Nano 2 aligns a 12B hybrid model with about 80B SFT tokens, rule- and reward-model feedback, on-policy DPO, GRPO and RLHF, then prunes/distills it to 9B while releasing the models and most training data.
Nemotron Nano 2 使用约 80B token 的 SFT、规则与奖励模型反馈、在线 DPO、GRPO 和 RLHF 对齐 12B 模型，再剪枝蒸馏至 9B，并发布模型与大部分训练数据。
why: It connects concrete data records, verifiers, optimization stages and compression recovery, and exposes enough released artifacts to audit much of the reasoning-data pipeline.
inclusion_reason: An unusually auditable frontier recipe linking released reasoning traces and tool trajectories to staged SFT, rule/RM feedback, on-policy DPO, GRPO/RLHF and compression distillation.

title: Problem
问题
html: Efficient reasoning models must preserve long traces and tool behavior while reducing inference cost, and their training claims are difficult to audit when alignment and compression are reported separately. Nemotron Nano 2 addresses both problems: it documents the data and feedback used to align a 12B hybrid model, then shows how pruning, forward-KL distillation, targeted RL, preference optimization, and checkpoint merging produce a 9B model. The audit question is how much of that pipeline is pinned by released records and where “majority of the data” still leaves gaps.
高效推理模型需要在降低推理成本的同时保留长推理轨迹与工具行为；当对齐和压缩被分开描述时，训练主张也很难审计。Nemotron Nano 2 同时处理这两个问题：报告先说明 12B 混合架构模型的对齐数据与反馈，再展示如何通过剪枝、前向 KL 蒸馏、定向 RL、偏好优化和检查点合并得到 9B 模型。审计重点是哪些环节已由发布记录固定，以及“发布了大部分数据”仍留下哪些缺口。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The recipe starts from Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, pretrained on 20T tokens and extended to 128K. Alignment uses about 80B tokens of prompt-response SFT data across reasoning, tool use, conversation, multilingual, and safety domains, followed by rule-verifier RL, on-policy DPO, Qwen-reward-model GRPO, RLHF, and checkpoint interpolation. The aligned 12B parent is then depth/width pruned and recovered with staged logit distillation at increasing sequence lengths. The final 9B model, sibling/base checkpoints, and most pre- and post-training data are released.

该配方从在 20T token 上预训练并扩展到 128K 上下文的 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 开始。对齐阶段使用约 80B token 的提示—回答 SFT 数据，覆盖推理、工具使用、对话、多语言与安全，随后执行规则验证器 RL、在线策略 DPO、采用 Qwen 奖励模型的 GRPO、RLHF 以及检查点插值。对齐后的 12B 父模型再经深度/宽度剪枝，并通过逐步增加序列长度的 logit 蒸馏恢复能力。最终 9B 模型、相关基础检查点以及大部分预训练和后训练数据均已发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
The SFT pool contains about 1.5M math, 1.1M coding, 2.0M science, 400K tool-calling, 1.5M conversational, 2K safety, and 5.0M multilingual samples. DeepSeek-R1-0528 generates math/science/code and safety responses; Qwen3-235B-A22B generates tool and chat data. Tool records include single-turn, multi-turn, and multi-step conversations in which Qwen simulates User, Assistant, and API Server agents; a rule layer retains only successful trajectories. Multilingual records translate English data line by line, enforce bracket extraction, and filter by language ID; safety responses pass guard models.

SFT has three stages: the broad mixture plus roughly 10% reasoning-stripped outputs for reasoning-off behavior; un-concatenated tool data to repair tool accuracy; and long-context plus traces abruptly truncated to 1–2K tokens while preserving final answers for budget control. IFEval RL uses 16K LMSYS prompts augmented with constraints and a rule verifier. WorkBench DPO generates on-policy positive/negative pairs from successful and failed tool trajectories, with correctness defined by database-state comparison. GRPO uses English HelpSteer3 contexts, generates rollouts with and without thinking, and scores them with a Qwen-based reward model. Reasoning and chat checkpoints are interpolated after a sweep.

For the 9B reasoning model, the aligned 12B parent is pruned to 56 layers and distilled with forward KL: 60B tokens at 8,192; after width pruning, 50B at 8,192, 25B at 49,152, and 1B at 262,144; then DPO, GRPO, 0.4B-token long-context KD, RLHF, and a 0.5 merge. Shorter-sequence KD uses 70% stage-2 post-training and 30% pretraining data; 262K KD uses stage-3 data only.

SFT 数据约含 150 万数学、110 万代码、200 万科学、40 万工具调用、150 万对话、2000 条安全以及 500 万多语言样本。DeepSeek-R1-0528 生成数学/科学/代码与安全回答，Qwen3-235B-A22B 生成工具和对话数据。工具记录包含单轮、多轮和多步交互，Qwen 分别模拟用户代理、助手代理与 API 服务器代理；规则验证层只保留成功轨迹。多语言记录逐行翻译英文数据，使用严格括号格式抽取并通过语言识别过滤；安全回答还需经过 guard 模型。

SFT 分三阶段：先训练完整混合数据，并为约 10% 的提示加入移除推理过程的回答以学习关闭推理；再用不拼接的完整工具数据修复工具准确率；最后加入长上下文数据以及把推理轨迹突然截断至 1–2K token、但保留最终答案的样本，以支持预算控制。IFEval RL 从 LMSYS 抽取 1.6 万条提示并添加约束，由规则验证器评分。WorkBench DPO 根据工具轨迹成功或失败在线生成正负偏好对，并以数据库状态对比判断正确性。GRPO 使用英文 HelpSteer3 上下文，同时生成带/不带思考的 rollout，再由 Qwen 奖励模型评分。推理与对话检查点经过系数扫描后插值合并。

对 9B 推理模型，先把对齐后的 12B 父模型剪到 56 层并使用前向 KL 蒸馏：序列长 8192 时训练 60B token；宽度剪枝后依次训练 50B@8192、25B@49152、1B@262144；随后执行 DPO、GRPO、0.4B token 长上下文 KD、RLHF 和 0.5 权重合并。短序列 KD 使用 70% 第二阶段后训练数据与 30% 预训练数据，262K 序列 KD 则完全使用第三阶段数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper directly reports the domain counts, teachers, filters, three SFT stages, IFEval verifier, WorkBench state predicate, Qwen reward model, merge sweep, and full compression/distillation schedule. It evaluates the aligned and compressed models on math, code, science, instruction following, tool use, long context, and chat, and reports 3–6× higher throughput than Qwen3-8B in generation-heavy settings while retaining competitive accuracy. These results support the efficiency claim, not the absence of data bias. Official Hugging Face pages independently expose the 9B/12B checkpoints and Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2; the dataset card provides category counts, generator models, prompt/response construction, and per-sample license metadata.

论文直接披露了各领域样本数、教师模型、过滤规则、三阶段 SFT、IFEval 验证器、WorkBench 状态终止条件、Qwen 奖励模型、合并系数扫描以及完整压缩/蒸馏日程。报告在数学、代码、科学、指令遵循、工具使用、长上下文与对话任务上评测对齐和压缩模型，并称在生成密集场景中相较 Qwen3-8B 获得 3–6 倍吞吐，同时保持有竞争力的准确率。这些结果支持效率主张，但不能证明数据无偏。官方 Hugging Face 页面另行发布 9B/12B 检查点和 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2；数据卡给出了类别数量、生成模型、提示/回答构造和逐样本许可元数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The report’s strongest contribution is end-to-end coupling of alignment data with compression recovery. Reasoning-off and deliberately truncated traces make inference budget a supervised data field; WorkBench turns database state into a terminal predicate for on-policy DPO; GRPO adds learned judgment for chat; post-RL KD and model merging explicitly recover capabilities lost during targeted optimization. The released dataset makes more of this pipeline auditable than a typical frontier report, although it is not an exact immutable snapshot of every record used.
该报告最突出的贡献，是把对齐数据与压缩恢复连成端到端流程。移除推理的回答和刻意截断的轨迹，把推理预算变成可监督的数据字段；WorkBench 将数据库状态转化为在线 DPO 的终止条件；GRPO 为对话加入学习式判断；RL 后 KD 与模型合并则显式恢复定向优化造成的能力损失。公开数据集使该流水线比一般前沿报告更可审计，但它并不是所有实际训练记录的精确、不可变快照。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper says it releases the majority—not all—of its data, so exact train-to-release correspondence is unproven. Rollout counts, sampling temperatures, reward calibration, DPO/RLHF pair volumes, human-feedback protocol, and post-training benchmark decontamination are not fully specified. Synthetic traces inherit DeepSeek/Qwen biases; the Qwen-based reward model may favor its own style. The official dataset mixes CC-BY-4.0 with smaller ODC-BY and CC-BY-SA subsets and warns that Qwen/DeepSeek terms may apply. Targeted GRPO and RLHF also caused benchmark regressions that required KD and model merging.

论文称发布了“大部分”而非全部数据，因此训练记录与发布记录无法逐条对应。rollout 数量、采样温度、奖励校准、DPO/RLHF 偏好对规模、人类反馈协议以及后训练基准去污染均未完整说明。合成轨迹会继承 DeepSeek/Qwen 偏差，Qwen 奖励模型也可能偏好自身风格。官方数据集以 CC-BY-4.0 为主，但混有少量 ODC-BY 和 CC-BY-SA，并提醒下游可能受 Qwen/DeepSeek 条款约束。定向 GRPO 与 RLHF 还造成了部分基准退化，需通过 KD 和模型合并恢复。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This Card is a practical blueprint for representing reasoning post-training as data transformations rather than a list of algorithms. It connects each record type—reasoning trace, reasoning-off answer, truncated trace, tool trajectory, preference pair, reward-scored rollout—to its generator, filter, feedback contract, optimizer, and downstream checkpoint. It is especially useful for studying controllable thinking budgets, verifiable tool-use preferences, staged distillation, and release-to-training audit gaps.
本卡可作为把推理后训练表示为“数据变换链”而非算法清单的实践蓝图。它把推理轨迹、关闭推理回答、截断轨迹、工具轨迹、偏好对和奖励评分 rollout 分别连接到生成器、过滤器、反馈契约、优化器与下游检查点。它尤其适合研究可控思考预算、可验证工具偏好、分阶段蒸馏以及发布数据与实际训练之间的审计缺口。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §3.1 for domain counts, synthetic teachers, tool simulation, translation, and safety filters.
  • Read §3.2 for the three SFT stages, IFEval rule reward, WorkBench on-policy DPO, HelpSteer3 GRPO, and checkpoint merging.
  • Read §4.3 for the exact pruning/KD token and sequence-length schedule and post-RL recovery.
  • Audit the official dataset’s per-item licenses and upstream Qwen/DeepSeek conditions before reuse.

• §3.1 给出领域规模、合成教师、工具模拟、翻译与安全过滤。
  • §3.2 给出三阶段 SFT、IFEval 规则奖励、WorkBench 在线 DPO、HelpSteer3 GRPO 与检查点合并。
  • §4.3 给出剪枝/KD 的 token 与序列长度日程，以及 RL 后能力恢复。
  • 复用前应审计官方数据集的逐样本许可及上游 Qwen/DeepSeek 条款。
